about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Mutant Menace (The Wise Mothman, BUG counters and rad/mill). Written from 12 stock goldfish games (seeds 23001-23012): stock kills on turn 11.3, casts Mothman on own turn 4 to 11 (median 5), never cast Bloatfly Swarm, Raul, Feral Ghoul, Struggle for Project Purity, Guardian Project or Contaminated Drink, and under-cast its ramp (Cultivate 1 of 5, Talisman of Dominance 1 of 5) and the counter doublers (Winding Constrictor, Hardened Scales held with the mana up). Rule 1: ramp first. Rule 2: the commander as soon as it can be cast (each mill of a nonland card of ours then grows the team). Rule 3: the counter doublers next, before the creatures they multiply. Rule 4: the engines (Raul, Hancock, Guardian Project, Inexorable Tide, Marcus, Scorchbeast, Mirelurk Queen). Rule 5: tap Raul in the first main phase so every player mills one before combat (Mothman, Mirelurk and Scorchbeast trigger on our own nonland mills), library 30 or more. Rule 6: the rest of the creatures, dearest first, whatever Forge thinks of them (Bloatfly Swarm was never cast by stock). Rule 7: Vault 87 and Struggle for Project Purity with 45 cards or more in the library (both draw). Rule 8: Biomass Mutation (AI:RemoveDeck:All) before combat at X 6 or more with three attackers. Rule 9: Contaminated Drink at X 3 or more with a short hand and a deep library. Rule 10: Harmonize. Rules 11-12: Strength Bobblehead's counters and Contagion Clasp's proliferate as after-combat mana sinks. Triggers: Scorchbeast's tokens and Radroach's return always; Tato Farmer's two rad counters on us only while Mothman or Scorchbeast turns our own mills into counters or tokens, with 50 cards left and 20 life. Answers (Putrefy, Atomize, Casualties of War, Nuclear Fallout, Find // Finality, Alpha Deathclaw's monstrosity, Rampaging Yao Guai, Mutational Advantage) are left to Forge for a second pass.
